proposals.current: Runs a Python script that is executed once and has access to all incoming data. This node uses an existing dedicated Python interpreter that must be set up in the application settings. To learn more about the JIPipe Python API, visit https://jipipe.hki-jena.de/apidocs/python-current/index.html
proposals.proposed: Runs a custom Python script that is executed once and has access to all incoming data. This node uses an existing dedicated Python interpreter that must be set up in the application settings. To learn more about the JIPipe Python API, visit https://jipipe.hki-jena.de/apidocs/python-current/index.html

proposals.current: Runs a Python script that iterates through each iteration step in the input slots. This node uses an existing dedicated Python interpreter that must be set up in the application settings. To learn more about the JIPipe Python API, visit https://jipipe.hki-jena.de/apidocs/python-current/index.html This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
proposals.proposed: Runs a custom Python script in merging mode: the script is executed once for each merged group of input data, so several data items can be processed together. The algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty. It uses a dedicated Python interpreter set up in the application settings; see https://jipipe.hki-jena.de/apidocs/python-current/index.html.

proposals.current: Runs a Python script that has direct access to all input data slots. This node uses Jython, a Java interpreter for Python that currently does not support native functions (e.g. Numpy), but can access all Java types.Input slots can be accessed from variables 'input_slots' (array), 'input_slots_map' (map from name to slot). Output slots can be accessed from variables 'output_slots' (array), 'output_slots_map' (map from name to slot).Slots are of their respective JIPipe types (JIPipeDataSlot) and are fully accessible from within Python. This algorithm is capable of running over multiple parameter sets via an additional slot. Automatically generated annotations generated based on the parameters are available as variable 'parameter_annotations'. Please do not forget to pass the annotations to the output if you want to want this.
proposals.proposed: Runs a custom Python script on Jython, a Java interpreter for Python, with direct access to all input data. Jython does not support native functions (e.g. Numpy), but can access all Java types.

proposals.current: Runs a Python script that iterates through each iteration step in one input slot. This node uses Jython, a Java interpreter for Python that currently does not support native functions (e.g. Numpy), but can access all Java types.Access to the iteration step is done via a variable 'data_batch' that provides access to all input and output data, as well as annotations. Input slots can be accessed from variables 'input_slots' (array), 'input_slots_map' (map from name to slot). The first (and only) input slot is also accessible via the 'input_slot' variable. Output slots can be accessed from variables 'output_slots' (array), 'output_slots_map' (map from name to slot).
proposals.proposed: Runs a custom Python script on Jython in the simple iterating mode: the script is executed once per data item in the single input, and access to the current item is done via the 'data_batch' variable, which provides access to all input and output data as well as annotations.

proposals.current: Runs a Python script that iterates through each iteration step in the input slots. This node uses Jython, a Java interpreter for Python that currently does not support native functions (e.g. Numpy), but can access all Java types.Each iteration step contains multiple input and output data items.Access to the iteration step is done via a variable 'data_batch' that provides access to all input and output data, as well as annotations. Input slots can be accessed from variables 'input_slots' (array), 'input_slots_map' (map from name to slot). Output slots can be accessed from variables 'output_slots' (array), 'output_slots_map' (map from name to slot). This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
proposals.proposed: Runs a custom Python script on Jython in merging mode: the script is executed once per merged group of input data, and each group is accessible via the 'data_batch' variable, which provides access to all input and output data as well as annotations. The algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations; those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
